messages:
claire: Quick thread to lock the private-deploy minimal roadmap for VPC/on-prem packaging + upgrade guarantees. Need ship gates and owners.

devon: Suggestion: GA supports two networking modes: cloud peering (preferred) and customer BGP. Relay stays experimental.

mike: Runtime constraints: we must guarantee IP continuity for the typed upgrade path. Plan: operator canary control-plane -> wait for KV warm -> roll data-plane. Provide a kubectl validation script.

sara: Field request: 10-min quickstart for netops + a sample peering email template (they want to forward it to their infra team). Also support playbook for 1-hr maintenance windows.

priya: Security gating: signed artifacts (tarball), BYO-KMS patterns, least-privilege IAM templates, and audit-log routing instructions for SIEM.

claire: Draft launch gates:
- Signed installer + offline tarball validated on 2 distros
- IP continuity tested across 2 clouds + one on-prem scenario
- Peering quickstart + IAM templates published
- BYO-KMS and audit-log guide published
- Customer-run smoke test and support playbook available
If any gate fails -> limited GA (field enablement only).

ops-bot: Created ticket RDW-PL-7102 "Private deploy: VPC/on-prem minimal GA gates"  assignees: @devon @mike @sara ETA: 10bd.

devon: I'll own signed artifacts and offline install flow.

mike: I'll build the IP-preservation harness + validation script.

sara: I'll draft the runbook and the customer email template.

claire: Cool. Drop drafts in /docs/private and tag this thread. Reconvene next Tue for sign-off. :thumbsup:
